title: Define runtime state transitions and event mapping
purpose: Turn the research state diagram into a concrete state/event contract for generic Agent runs.
scope: Define run states: Accepted, Planning, Planned, AwaitingApproval, Executing, Observing, Verifying, Completed, Denied, Suspended, RollbackPending, Recovering, FailedClosed.
Map each state transition to required audit events and persisted run-state updates.
Define idempotency rules for repeating a transition after crash/restart.
Define failure handling for model errors, tool errors, policy denial, approval timeout, verification failure, and rollback failure.
Define which transitions are allowed to be triggered by TUI/API input.
acceptance_criteria: Every state transition has a durable source of truth.
No transition can erase earlier audit evidence.
Recovery behavior is deterministic when a run stops in each non-terminal state.
Approval timeout and denial do not produce EffectPrepared for the protected step.
verification: Table-review all states against research.md state diagram.
Check that each non-terminal state has a recovery policy.
Add state-transition test cases to the downstream AgentCore task list.
risk_notes: The core risk is creating a runtime that can advance based on memory-only state and lose truth after restart.
